name: dread_presence_mode_one_draw_a_card_lose_1_life
notes: Printed: 'Whenever a Swamp you control enters, choose one - You draw a card and you lose 1 life. / This creature deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.' Seat 0 plays a Swamp and picks the first mode: seat 0 draws exactly one card (its own top card, Library 5; the opponent's library is untouched) and goes to 19. Nobody is damaged and nobody gains life.
